**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove __cause__ method override on custom exceptions**

Defining `__cause__` as a method here overrides Python’s special exception-chaining attribute with a bound method, so when this exception is logged or formatted (`traceback.print_exc()`, error middleware, etc.) traceback handling can crash with `AttributeError` instead of showing the original failure. This is reproducible when `PreconditionEvaluationError` is raised via `raise ... from exc` (and the same pattern appears in `PostconditionEvaluationError`), which means contract evaluation errors can break error reporting in production paths.
